this prof is a truly nice guy; and he will help you if you come to his office/email him and his background is impressive. although this class if more for anthro, zoology, bio majors than anyone else, it is a fair class, albeit not one you can sleep through to get an A. just come to lecture.

How could you like this guy?!  By a wide margin the worst teacher I've had since gradeschool.  Takes a fascinating subject and stuffs it deep into the Ivory Tower in a truly obnoxious way.  Fixated on trivia (memorizing number of individual bones he found during last summer's field school, etc.).
The lectures were pretty boring, exams were extremely difficult
PEople are crazy... Bunn's a great prof... very knowledgable.  Very willing to talk during office hours.  Travelled to most of the places he lectures on--- I loved this class.
The lectures were extremely boring, but his exam was pretty fair
I thought he was a good lecturer and he really answers questions well.  i also think his test questions are really fair representations of what we've covered in class.
Very interesting lecturer.  Some people just don't like the material I guess...
No Comments
I really liked him.  the info was interesting and i thought it was conveyed well.

He is more boring than the dead things he talks about.  The lectures are impossible to get through even if you took four aderol pills and weighed a 104 pounds.  Don't go to lecture just READ THE BOOK.
Although he knows his material, he wasn't able to convey ideas he tested to the class. His test questions were ambigious. I would not recommend taking him.
Boring as hell

Professor Sarlioglu is so kind and understanding. He truly wants the best for his students. 230 is one of the hardest classes (a flipped classroom) I've taken but he ended up curving the entire class by a decent amount. You have to attend class and stay really on top of content or it stacks up fast.
Professor Bulent was very knowledgeable about the material and spoke very clearly. Would take a class with this professor again.

Professor Bulent was great he made a great effort teaching the material in lecture and was clearly passionate. The coursework itself was flipped so you had to study before hand a lot but overall pretty achievable.

230 is a flipped classroom, but still a solid professor. He is understanding (5 extra minutes on midterms), and describes how to set up circuit problems. The course itself demands a mix of memorization and application, which the professor follows w/ good balance. Occasionally makes mistakes, but nothing more than a sign flip.

Derrick is such an amazing and caring professor. He was flexible with due dates and offered extra credit if needed. I took Art 222 and it was one of my favorite classes I have taken, so I definitely recommend him.
He is such a caring and chill guy, he's super flexible and always willing to help. He offers revisions if you want to earn more points on projects, as well as extra credit opportunities.
Cared deeply about students and their success. Empathic and flexible with accommodations.

Derrick is a very chill professor, with a somewhat quirky, dry humor. I had ART222. Most of the class he gave us the prompt and some vague direction, and then let us loose to paint, with the ability to use him as a resource. He'll go over the exact points of why he's giving you a grade, with the ability change your work for a higher one.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Derrick is awesome! He keeps it real and is always lenient on due dates and project ideas.

Beyond amazing - doesn't make you do annoyingly specific projects. You guide your learning and use him as a resource. I look up my instructors art before and after taking a class, and I got a new vibe from his work after having him as an instructor. He's quiet, yet awkwardly funny. Opposite of his pop art style, which makes his art more intriguing.

Great prof with an easy-going personality. Positive reinforcement teaching style. Gives detailed assignments, but talks one-on-one with students making sure everything's clear. Very knowledgable in color and painting techniques. He is very strict with time, and the class time is 8:50. Make sure you are good at time management if you want to take it

Great prof with an easy-going personality. Positive reinforcement teaching style.  Gives detailed assignments, but talks one-on-one with students making sure everything's clear. Very knowledgable in color and painting techniques. Shares real life experience in the art world which is helpful if you're not sure what to do after college.

Great prof with an easy-going personality. Positive reinforcement  teaching style. Late comers receive a gentle scolding. Gives detailed assignments, but talks one-on-one with students making sure everything's clear. Very knowledgable in color and painting techniques, and happy to pontificate about music as well.

Derrick is AWESOME!! He's got a hilarious dry sense of humor and a low-key personality. I learned a lot of really cool stuff in this class. He gives great feedback & help when you want it. The project guidelines are very loose & there is minimal outside work. I loved this class & looked forward to it every week.

Professor Burden is great. He makes the issues of elections clear in a digestible and fairly non-partisan format and feels more down-to-earth than most professors. His intelligence is also very clear, but he never felt like he talked down to us. His lectures were quite topical and focused with room for questions/participation. Light readings.

Dr. Burden is probably one of favorite professors at this school. He knows everything about American politics and often does panel talks for the University related to that field. The lectures are interesting and focus on concepts you would cover in a civics class. However, I never opened the textbook, and I'm not even sure why he assigns one.

I took two classes with Professor Burden, and both were great. Exams are most of your grade & draw on readings/lectures, so making sure that you do the readings and know main ideas is really important. Lectures were amazing and taught me a lot, and going over them before exams helps you figure out what the key terms for short ID are going to be.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I enjoyed this class and all of the discussions. This is such an interesting field of study. My only issue with Barry Burden is his lack of staying non bias. While it is clear that he tries to stay non partisan, many times throughout the semester his political side would show which did not help when trying to form your own opinion.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Burden has been the best professor I have had at this school. He is great to talk to and great to listen to. He knows what he is talking about and conveys his knowledge in interesting ways. His research is very interesting and definitely worth a read. I would 100% recommend any of his classes to any student.

Great man, great professor. Where some seem actively annoyed by the prospect of teaching, he is patient and enthusiastic without being too much. He will let you put in as much as you want for a course, and will happily take extra time for you if you have the drive.

I always enjoyed lectures and how he put concepts together into a cohesive fabric of understanding the electoral process. However, I found grading to be quite strict: if you do not write your exams and organize points in a certain way/manner, you are not going to perform well, even if you are extremely knowledgeable about the material as I was.

Second class with Prof Burden and I still can't rate him more highly! Very knowledgable, respectful, and genuinely cares about his students! Class is easy because it's mostly common sense just pay attention. Extra points because he's a dilf and I would marry him in an instant. Also, make sure to attend lect and section- they're graded!

This class was super interesting and informative! You will need the textbook and will need to do the readings. Make sure to go to lecture as there are graded lecture check ins (isn't announced, just in syllabus so make sure to read). Exams are straightforward, open note, and online but are timed so use it wisely.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Lectures are essential because midterms & final are based almost entirely on them, textbook reading is helpful but not required because usually gone over in lecture but separate article readings are important, 2 midterms and a final (plus a forecasting project, pretty easy), going to TAs for midterm prep is helpful and prepare lots b/c only 3 exams

Prof. Burden is a great professor and does an excellent job at explaining what Congress does and how it operates. There are three exams, all of which are open book, open note, and take home. There is one paper but it is pretty easy. This was an interesting and relatively easy class if you do the work!

Professor Burden's lectures are concise and clear. They start with current events which is fun. He only puts a few bullet points on his slides, but write down what he expands on. You have to refer to lecture themes on exams that are not present in the book. The grading for exams is a tough. Burden is a really nice guy who cares about his students.

The professor is clearly knowledgeable in the material, but by far one of the worst graders I have ever had (Senior here). Reduces points arbitrarily, you must attend all discussion sections without fail, and you will be penalized if you use specific definitions from your notes on your tests. Don't take this class, there are so many better Poli Sci
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Burden's class was amazing. There were two papers, a midterm, and a final due throughout the semester. His lectures were engaging and informative. I also like how he kept a focus on current events as well. This class was super interesting and would definitely recommend!

Burden is a really great prof. He seems to be pretty well renowned in the real world as well. Probably the most interesting/relevant course I've taken at UW. 1 short paper, 2 exams. Exams are pretty easy if you take lecture notes and go to discussion. if you are taking this class bc it interests you, you will do great. hard to get lower than B

I really enjoyed going to Professor Burden's lectures. The way that he presented the information made it easy to learn. It is important to go to class and pay attention because there is not much information put on the slides that are posted online. He did go over readings in class, but it is important to review them right before the exam.

Burden is one of the more respected Political Science professors in the country. UW-Madison had to work to keep him from moving to an ivy league school and it shows. Informative and interesting lectures, strong availability. One of my favorite classes since I stepped on campus.

Dr. Burden is one of my favorite professors at UW. Hes incredibly intelligent, and always clear in lecture when explaining concepts. Hes very helpful in office hours, and it was always pretty obvious what was going to be on the exams. The readings matter, so dont skip them.

Professor Burden is an awesome lecturer. Gives solid powerpoints that are easy to understand. He doesn't get off tasked easily. Super nice guy if you see him in office hours. Has tons of knowledge on the subject matter. Class isn't difficult at all if you do the readings and go to lecture. You won't want to miss them cause they're really good.

For those who are Poli Sci majors I would definitely recommend his classes. He is extremely smart and knowledgable about the topics he presents. Does a great job of staying in the middle of the aisle.

Professor Burden does a great job with making this class interesting. Although some parts of the class are very slow (think congressional procedure), he tries his best to get through them as fast as possible. His lectures rely on you to listen to what he is saying, as he uses ppt slides as more of an outline and not packed with info. Funny & nice.

Hands down THE MOST BORING PROFESSOR I've ever had, and that's coming from a political science major. Lectures are long and he is so monotone. His slides do NOT help and you have to listen or read. Tests were alright in difficulty.

I loved US Congress! Prof Burden was excellent and his lectures were crystal-clear. Some material (legislative procedure) was long but overall interesting course. Three midterm tests. Multiple choice, short answer (and on the final short essays). You have to READ the chapters and you'll ace the tests! Articles can probably be skimmed.

Really, really good prof. Very knowledgeable. Show up to lecture every day and take very good notes. Everything on the exams comes straight from lecture material. Reading the book can be helpful but not necessary. Exams seem easy, but multiple choice makes up 70% of each midterm. Miss a few MC questions and your whole exam score is in the toilet.

He is the best! He did a great job explaining Ochem making it actually understandable and sometimes fun. It takes time and effort but If you pay attention in lecture and keep up with problem sets you will do well. He provides many practice exams which are just like the actual exams. I wish all professors were like him, fav Dr. Pepper enthusiast :)
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Bowman is easily the best Ochem 2 professor that I had. He paces out the lectures and makes the content very easy to learn. The class is graded only on 4 exams and a few quizzes, but he allows for 1 exam drop and exam retakes if you score below 40%. As long as you pay attention and do all of the homework sets, then you will be ready for his exams!

A gem among instructors. Excellent lecturer, passionate and caring, and goes above and beyond to make himself accessible to students. Everything is laid out clearly, and he genuinely wants students to succeed. Always makes time for student questions and is very willing to explain things more if needed.

Hated O-chem however he made me hate it less, very quirky and funny guy, who is very knowledgable about ochem. Never went to office hours, probably why I almost failed the class, however the professor was very good and made a horrible ochem experience, much better. If you're taking ochem, this is the guy to have.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
He's probably one of the best teacher in hemistry department, friendly, helpful, exam easy if you practice enough. 
But my advice is, if you want to become an organic chemist in the future, if you plan to take more upper-level and complex ochem courses, Matt might not your best choice.

Matt's lectures were very in depth and were very easy to understand. He was also very willing to answer student questions and provided multiple opportunities for office hours before exams to ensure that students knew what they were being tested on. The practice exams were also very helpful because they were all the same format as the real exams.

At first I thought he was just goofy but it turns out he REALLY KNOWS not just the material, but also how to teach it. The subject is hard and he knows that, he is open about it being a weed-out class, but follow his lectures, do the practice problems, and be at the discussions to participate and ask questions and you'll be all good.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall he is a nice guy who is very accessible if you need help outside of class. His teaching was just a little all over the place for me and his half explanations didn't really help (in his syllabus he even states that he doesn't know what he's doing). He's clearly knowledgeable but I didn't love his actual teaching style
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Bowman is a saint. Orgo is intimidating, but he isn't! He was so approachable and genuinely helpful during office hours, and his practice exams are such good practice for the real thing. His lectures always went by really fast and I really enjoyed having him as a professor.
He is the best. Super straightforward lecture and exams.

Honestly I don't love him as much as everyone else does--he prefers listing out his rules for solving problems instead of explaining why. Honestly I rarely went to discussion and studied last minute-ish so I know I could have done better if I had more time (overdid it this sem.) His practice tests are just like the class and exams are fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Matt was awesome! Although the class was only graded on a few things he gave tons of extra work that was super helpful. One of the best professors I've had at UW

Why is everyone glazing??? His lectures were unorganized, and he would go on 30 minute tangents on things you would never see again. He would rarely tell you what topic we were discussing, and if class ended in the middle of a topic, you would be lucky to even go over it in the next class. He's also not funny and would slurp soda in the mic.

Matt is an amazing O-Chem professor and I would highly recommend him any day of the week. He gives problem sets every lecture to practice what you have learned in lecture- and they are not graded. He gives tons of practice exams which is VERY similar to the real exam. TAKE MATT!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Matt is a kind and supportive professor who is very available and understanding. However, his class lacks structure, especially in lectures, which is very frustrating if you rely on clear explanations and organized teaching. If you're an independent learner who prefers figuring things out on your own, this class will work great for you.
Oh golly gee, where do I even start. Matt Bowman is GOAT. Exams were lowkey a little tough but fair. He teaches the content concisely and accurately. Take this man if you can.

Highly recommend Matt. Not overly difficult with him because he was awesome. He hand wrote notes on the projector which was easy to follow in lectures. Extra office hours occurred prior to exams. Problem sets were optional but SUPER helpful. Exams were representative of covered content if you studied diligently. #imissmybro
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great guy, held endless hours of office hours the weekends before exams. Cared about students. Explained things slowly and clearly. One warning is that he teaches the class very differently from the other professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He was an okay professor. He did seem like he liked the material that he was teaching and he tried to joke around with the class. He did however went over example extremely fast not allowing time for students to write them down.

Oh boy oh boy, where do I even begin. Some people may think Lebron or Jordan is the GOAT, but they have never attended a Bowman lecture. This may seem like glazing, but it's not glaze if its Bowman. His exams have clear guidelines, and he gives loads of practice. He is a great lecturer and is extremely committed to helping you learn. GOAT status
Super great professor, the way he explains things really helped me understand this class, and usually I suck at chemistry!

Dr. Bowman is super helpful and accessible outside of class. He genuinely cares about his students. I found his lectures slow and hard to sit through but he offers tons of resources to help you succeed. 343 is hard no matter what prof you have but I would recommend taking it with him. Great prof. I would take with 345 with him given the choice!!

Matt Bowman was a really good lecturer and helped break down difficult content. He can be a little all over the place in lecture but he'll take the time to make sure concepts really stick. Super available outside of class and genuinely cares about the success of his students. Lots of practice exams that are basically identical to the real thing.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The coolest, quirkiest guy on campus. Class is difficult because it's OChem, but you know what you're getting into. Has incredibly engaging lectures, is open and available, and is hilarious. Very test heavy, but he posts so many practice exams and study materials. Tough but fair grading policies. Plays by his own rules, but an incredible professor.

Prof. Bowman gives engaging lectures and useful lecture notes. He sets very clear expectations on what will be on the test, and there are lots of practice problems. Organic chemistry is a very difficult subject, but this class was manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Pretty good for 343, would not recommend for 345 since his style varies and won't be of much help for 344.

Had him for both 343 and 345 and can't recommend him enough! Provided lots of ungraded practice problems and was very accessible outside of class. Matt's lectures are pretty easy to follow and the practice tests he provides the week prior to an exam are VERY much in line with what you'll see on the test. One of the best teachers I've had at UW.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Don't take ochem if you can't get into Bowman's lectures. He is accommodating, knowledgeable, and most importantly an expert at actually TEACHING the material. He releases tons of practice problems well ahead of exams which is a godsend. The class is very challenging but Bowman is your best shot at ochem success at UW.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Bowman was good at teaching by giving many practice problems. He was very helpful with preparing for exams as he gave more practice exams than any other college class.

Matt definitely made O Chem bearable. He explained the topics in a way that was not daunting or overwhelming and helped us to understand the material fully. Would highly recommend taking this course with him.

Hardest class that I have taken in a while, but with Matt Bowman anything is possible. He made all his students feel welcome, and he had very clear expectations and plenty of availability to meet with him and answer questions.

Such a kind professor who clearly truly cares about his students. He explains concepts clearly and always has extra office hours on weekends before exams. He makes students feel capable about taking a difficult class and exams are never a surprise. Extremely grateful to have taken organic chemistry with Matt.
Obviously the topic was difficult but the professor made the class enjoyable and more understandable. He was also very kind and caring during a face-to-face encounter.
He's definitely very enthusiastic and an entertaining lecturer.  At times the class felt a bit disorganized.

The best professor I have had. Period. Cares about his students and their success, demonstrated by his extensive office hours during week AND on weekends (in 5-6 hour intervals before exams). Above all, Matt is an incredible human being with an immaculate sense of humor and a Dr. Pepper in hand that levels well with his students. Highly recommend.

One of the best professors I've had for any course. You can tell he's passionate about the course content and wants his students to succeed. He gives a lot of practice material and additional video lectures on each topic he covers. We had two take-home quizzes and four exams. He made ochem a very manageable and even fun class!

Matt was one of the most accessible professors I have ever had. He sets up extensive office hours before exams(like 5-6 hrs)and never passes up a question during or after lectures. He posts lecture recordings without fail and is super quick with piazza. Matt will never make you feel like you have a dumb question and truly cares about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor. Very knowledgeable and straightforward in what he expects from his students. Only warning is that your grade will be determined by only a few things. However, he is always willing to help and very open to going out of his way for others. Would recommend him if you plan to take organic chemistry!

THE BEST chem professor you will have, genuinely. Your final grade is heavily dependent on exams, (and 2 quizzes). It's organic chemistry, it's hyped up for a reason. Just memorize and practice a lot. Bowman makes it very clear and honest what you need to know.

Matt is by far the best teacher I have had for chemistry. He is knowledgeable and personable and takes time out of his day for each of his students if needed. He answers questions clearly and doesn't mind repeating himself. The class is based exclusively off of exams and quizzes so keep that in mind when you sign up if you aren't a strong tester.

I was shocked by how much I learned during lectures; Matt explains the concepts so well compared to the other professors I've had. I just wish there were more check-ins to keep me accountable. He cares a lot about his students and makes himself available to help.
made ochem fun. Also he has an insane amount of office hours. He clearly LOVES to teach

Bowman rules. He's very good at teaching you what you actually need to know for the test. He's funny and chill. All the lectures are recorded and he provides a whole bunch of study material too. OChem SUCKS but thats not his fault. 10/10 would recommend

Matt Bowman is the best professor I have ever had at UW-madison. I was super scared going into Ochem 1, but he made it seem learning it was something anyone was capable of. Had a ton of extra office hours the week before the exam and was always very approachable and gave great feedback on questions. Would definitely recommend him!!!

Matt is incredibly funny, caring, and quirky. Love his personality. I liked that he didn't rush thru lecture content too fast. He gives you all the resources you need to succeed plus more. HOWEVER ochem was the nastiest most horrible class ever so consider a tutor if chem isn't your jam like me. If you have to take it, take it w Matt & good luck!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you are a bio major and have to take OC class. Please, please, please choose Matt! He's an amazing and knowledgeable teacher who cares about his students a lot. A funny and weird guy. I know OC may be most of the students like me, sometimes boring and quite difficult to understand. But he can show your the mechanism clearly and the rules behind.

Matt was a great professor. I had him for two courses and he was wonderful, he wants students to do well and provides every possible resource for you to be able to do so. He is also extremely understanding in times of emergency: when I had a family crisis he rearranged a time for me to take the final exam. If you have to take ochem, get Matt.

Best teacher I've ever had. Honestly cares about his students, puts in a lot of time outside of class to make sure we understand things. Just take all your ochem lectures with Matt and you won't regret it.

Matt is the best. So many extra office hours that are extremely useful.  His practice exams set you up for the actual exams nicely, and you get notecards, so literally just write everything you learned on them. I had him for 343 and 345 and I wouldn't want any other professor. He made Ochem not only bearable, but fun.

Matt is absolutely perfect and the best Professor I've ever had. He genuinely cares about our success. He is very straight forward and clearly identifies what we need to know for exams and quizzes. I had him for both Chem 343 and 345 and love his lecture style. He never goes a lecture without a Dr. Pepper and he is so relatable and awesome. GO MATT

Matt amazed me all semester with how he added so many office hours and made himself available for students. He knew if there was a tough topic coming up, he would add extra office hours. O chem definitely isnt easy, but it was doable for someone like me who isnt as motivated to study all the time. Lectures are recorded and he always has extra stuff

Ochem is a hard class. That being said, Matt is the best person to teach it if you have to take it. My least favorite thing about Matt is that the entire class is basically graded on the exams. My favorite thing about him is his office hours and supply of practice problems. This is the only class I've taken where both went beyond what I needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best lecturer ever seen in ochem. Maybe the easiet quizs and exams among all ochem sections. Matt is such an interesting guy who will open a can of Dr. Pepper while talking on lecture mic, which might be the only I can never agree with him... I mean, coca-cola is the best

Matt is an incredible person who cares about his students. There were ample practice materials and supplementary videos. His lectures were winding and disorganized. He often had no transitions in thought or even labels to concepts. There were unspoken rules to problems he wouldn't outright mention in lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed having him for Organic Chem, he made a really tough class less stressful and understood what students were going through with the material. He made it very clear what would be on each exam and quiz, and gave every resource needed to do well in the class. He was extremely accessible outside class with many office hours. Take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I am someone who struggles in chemistry and was extremely nervous about taking organic chemistry, however Dr. Bowman made my experience the best I could ask for! All lectures are recorded and he described concepts in a very digestible manor. Numerous practice exams that are identical to the concepts that will be tested on exams to help students.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Matt is an incredible professor. This is not an easy class, but if you put in the work and ask for help, Matt will help you. Textbook is optional and entire class is graded on 3 quizzes and 4 tests. He puts out practice problems but there is no homework for grade. If you put in the time and work on your own, it is possible to do well in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Bowman is a phenomenal lecturer. He teaches with passion, effectively and efficiently. It is a difficult class with challenging concepts and he makes it much less intimidating than it otherwise could be. Exams are difficult but he is a very fair grader and the curve ends up working out. It's graded by few things, but all ochem classes are.

Dr. Bowman makes Organic Chemistry seem much easier than how it is explained in the provided textbook and he posts practice exams that look exactly like the actual exams which greatly reduces the stress during the exam. Furthermore, he is open to explaining chemistry topics even if they are outside the scope of the class.

Incredibly kind and understanding - went out of his way to work with me when I had to take incompletes in all my classes halfway through the semester. Grade based on 3 tests and 4 quizzes, but drops the lowest of each. Funny, clear, and interesting lectures. UNDERSTAND+DO THE PRACTICE TESTS and you'll be fine.

Matt is an amazing professor. He hand writes his lectures during class time so they are easy to follow. Many practice problems, practice exams, and recorded lecture topics are posted to supplement lectures. Exams can be tough but practice exams are very helpful and Matt is frequently available for office hours especially weekends before exams.

Bowman is an amazing teacher. But he does expect a lot of his students, so, if you don't put the effort in, you won't do well. Definitely go to his office hours. I suck at chem, but I went to them and I was able to do pretty well on tests, so take advantage of them. Our grade is only based on tests and quizzes though which sucked.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Matt is awesome!! Easily the best professor I've had. Took him for both 343 and 345 and he keeps the same relative exam and lecturing style for both classes. Exams are difficult, but it is organic chemistry. He gives a ton of resources for preparing for exams (problem sets, practice exams, office hours). Take him if you can!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: matt is the best professor ive had at uw. he is very accessible outside of class and you can tell he cares about his students. he knows his class if hard but is always willing to help. his exams are difficult but pretty fair and you are well prepared if you do his practice exams. if youre taking ochem take it with matt!!!

Matt Bowman is an awesome professor. I had a really rough semester, and was considering dropping out this class. Matt made time for me outside of his office hours, to help me review my past exams. He is super caring and helped me pass this very difficult course. He knows his class is hard, but wants his students to succeed.

Matt was a GREAT professor and very personable! I really enjoyed the class even though I did poorly (o-chem just did not mesh well with me no matter how hard I tried). He was very communicative, and understanding, and often cracked jokes in lectures. Would take this course with him again!

BEST PROFESSOR EVER! People always complains Ochem is hard, but he made it so understanding. He was available many HOURS over the weekend before tests (unheard of). I'm not saying it's a walk in the park , but if you watch all his lectures, do all the practice problems, all the practice exams, and go to office hours when confused you'll do great!

I literally could not ask for a better ochem prof. Matt makes things simple to understand and his exams are super fair and he doesn't try to trick you. I was SO scared to take ochem because everyone says it's one of the hardest classes. Not with Matt! Matt was amazing. Ochem is a hard class, there is no way around that. But he gives you all the resources you need to succeed and is readily available outside class to help. I had heard nothing but good things about him, but he has NO idea how to teach an online class. It is literally a blank white screen for over an hour, monotone slow voice and zero engagement is even possible. Not sure if this is useful because I am sure he will never have to teach it this way again

Professor Bowman was awesome! His lectures were pre-recorded and very easy to follow. I dreaded organic chemistry coming into this class but he made it my favorite chemistry class yet! Tests were fair and he provided plenty of extra help and office hours.

Matt is seriously the epitome of your modern-day professor. O-Chem sucks in general but he's there for you through it. He clearly loves his job, his subject, his TAs, and his students. Easily my favorite professor thus far. He's always available for questions (so don't be afraid to ask!)

Best prof I ever met so far my entire life! He has extra office hours over the weekend at Union South before every exams, like the entire weekend. Cannot express
Best Prof ever met!!!!! He is such an inspirational teacher and makes ochem so much fun.

Hands down the best professor at UW. He makes him self SO accessible outside of class. I don't think he sleeps. His lectures are funny, and even better, straight forward. Matt Bowman is literally a gift from heaven. I have never met a professor more accomodating than him. He truly wants his students to succeed and will give them all the resources necessary. Matt Bowman is a God. During the COVID-19 pandemic he posted lectures early and allowed us to earn extra points for studying. I love this man

O chem is extremely difficult, but Matt does his very best to make this class manageable. His lectures are thorough and comprehensive and he provides packets of pertinent practice problems for each lecture. DO THE PROBLEM SETS! I was very bad at organic chemistry and discouraged due to my past ochem professor, but Matt made me enjoy it and he taught it well. Hes fair, smart, respectable, and overall knows how to teach. Given that OCHEM is generally a tough course, he tries his best and simplifies concepts greatly. It is a lot of memorization but he succeed in making the material to make more sense. I'd rather slowly peel my tongue off a cold pole than read an OChem textbook, but Matt's lectures are so engaging. He is so superior to every other OChem prof, it is hilarious. Everything you want in a prof: MATT. The weekend before every exam Matt sits in Union South for 20+ HOURS to help people with Chemistry. Literally could not be better.

Matt is a great professor. He is available a lot outside of class for questions, especially before the exam (he would host like 8 hour office hour sessions). Matt is the best! If nothing else convinces you, he held five hours of office hours on a Sunday! If you're reading this because you're wondering if you should pick him, DO IT!

Great professor. I chose to take his summer chem 345 specifically because he was not teaching it in the fall. I wish he was going to teach chem 344 as well. I've had him for both semesters and he really is the best. He genuinely cares for his students by holding lots of office hours and giving us the resources to succeed. Simply amazing, I struggled a lot, but by the second semester, I pulled through. He has a lot of office hours, where you can have fun and get so much help. Matt was a GREAT instructor and was always open to answering questions during and outside of lecture. He also provides LOTS of practice material that is extremely helpful for the exams. Overall a really great guy.

Matt is purely AMAZING. He is an incredible professor. O chem is a doable course as long as you put in the time outside of class. His exams are challenging, but fair if you put in the time studying. Matt is a great lecture. He really helps build a good foundation in the subject for you to move forward with. All the others commenters here are indeed correct. No one has mentioned though that he does use favoritism: I've only ever seen him drinking Dr Pepper.

Bowman's lectures are very thorough about explaining why a reaction works the way it does, and he gives insightful ways of thinking about reactions. Matt is an AMAZING professor. I struggle a lot with chemistry, but he makes it all worth it. He gives great feedback and is very supportive of making student's dreams come true. He has a quick wit making difficult content easier to understand. 10/10, if I had to take him again I would.
great professor!

By far the best professor I have ever had at UW Madison, which is saying something. If you get a chance to take a class with Bowman, do it. The lectures are both hilarious and informative. Matt Bowman is seriously the greatest! Organic chemistry is one of the hardest experiences of my academic career, but he made it bearable! The amount of resources he provides is incredible. The nature of the course make the material really difficult but he actually makes ochem fun and doable.

Best professor I've had in the chemistry department by far. Bowman made organic chemistry fun and interesting and much less terrifying. Inspired me to change my major! If you have to take organic chemistry, do yourself a favor and take it with Bowman. He gives more than ample practice and teaches in an engaging manner. Great Professor!
Best Teacher I've ever,  made OChem a gift rather than a curse

Ocher is hard, but Matt definitely makes it interesting! He is very clear and teaches the material in an easy to follow manner. His exams can be hard but do all the practice exams he posts and you'll know exactly what to expect. Highly recommend him. He makes ochem really cool while teaching you a ton.

He has so many resources online its insane. online videos, multiple practice tests, step by step mechanisms written out, and more just to make sure you understand everything.  The best professor I've ever had.

Matt is a very good, clear lecturer. He is also a very nice and helpful man as well, and he is one of the best teachers I have had here at UW (third-best chemistry professor I have had, top five overall). His lectures are clear, and he has a sense of humor.  His problem sets are very good. I would definitely take him again. I'm a chem major.

Best O Chem prof out there.  There's no way to make the material easier, only more manageable. Matt does this with very clear examples, multiple practice exams with video answer keys, outside videos and power points, and a lot of office hours. Make sure you know your stuff for pop quizzes in discussion.

ALWAYS go to his office hours! Why take Bowman if not for his teaching skills. Cool and awesome guy, as is his taste in books. Slightly tough class though, try not to screw up any tests, like I did for my first  :(

Excellent professor and grader. My TA wasn't super helpful, but I still understood the material because Matt was so approachable. He doesn't give homework, but he gives a lot of optional homework-like material to help prepare for the exams that I recommend doing. He wants his students to pass, and it shows.

If you take OChem, take it with Matt. He provides problem sets, practice exams that are exactly like the real exams, extra practice, and online notes and video lectures.  You will have to work hard, but if you do the problem sets and practice exams, you will do fine.  Lectures aren't mandatory but completely worth going to.  No textbook required.

Even if you have to rearrange your entire schedule to take 343/5 with Matt, it's definitely worth it. I've never seen an instructor so dedicated. His lectures are crystal clear, and he provides so many resources (problem sets, lecture notes/videos, 10 hours office hours/wk, 5 practice exams). Organic chemistry is NOT easy- ATTEND HIS OFFICE HOURS!

I also had Matt for 343, he is by far my favorite teacher at UW!  He is a great at teaching, I stress teaching, b/c I can't stand prof that just point at ppt slides.  He gives tons of practice exams, which are very close to his actual exams.  I did not attend very many dis sessions and still did well.  Do the pkts he gives you and you'll do great!!

The guy you MUST take for o chem. Super helpful by providing every material you need to pass the class. Doing the problem sets giving to practice your understanding, the looks-exactly-like-the-exam practice exams, video lectures, etc. - he gives you adequate material, you just have to use them! He's funny so lectures are fun to go to.

Fantastic lecturer and everyone understood the subject, which was my main problem with the course. Everyone understood the topics so well, the exam averages were incredible high compared to normal ochem exam averages so there was basically no curve. He teaches so well that if you have to score above a 90 on every exam to get an A.

Bowman is hands down the best professor I've had. He genuinely cares that his students do well and makes ochem manageable and understandable. He holds office hours nearly every day and provides students with an extensive amount of practice material, including 4-5 practice exams that mirror the format of the actual exam. Bowman for ochem is a must!

Bowman is a really caring professor.  I had to miss two tests last minute due to medical issues and he was great about letting me make them up.  He holds tons of office hours.  However, the class material is kind of tough.  He's definitely the best professor teaching O Chem at UW.

Class is only worth 3 credits but I put 6 credits worth of work into it to get an A. Bowman is an amazing professor though. Funny and willing to meet any time outside of class to help you out. I suggest that you hire an undergrad tutor to help reinforce his ideas. I got one that was only 10$ an hour that was fantastic. Exams are really tough though

Bowman is awesome - genuinely have nothing negative to say about him. He takes a difficult subject like O-Chem and breaks it down into digestable chunks for students. He really takes an interest in students and hopes they do well. Answers questions well, makes lecture interesting - heck he's so good you don't need to buy the book!

Best teacher at UW thus far. He is quirky and quite hilarious. He makes expectations clear. Many practice exams given. Had office hours this semester on average about 4 hrs a day, 5 days a week (last semester he had less but still had a respectable amt). He also comes in on weekends before exams to answer questions. Most dedicated teacher I know

He's such a cool dude. Organic chemistry is a tough subject, but Matt will help you with any and all questions you have. He's relate-able and interesting to listen to in class. I highly recommend taking a class with him if you need to take organic chemistry!

Matt cares about his students and sets you up for doing well in his class.  The biggest complaint from my end is that his curve can be set high because everyone does well; our average on exams was usually well above 70, which is high for an second-semester o-chem class.  Most definitely take him if you have the chance, you won't regret it.

Matt is the only professor I will take for o chem.  He does as much as he can to help you succeed in the class.  His office hours are unbelievably helpful and he has them all the time.  He gives problem sets after each lecture and 5 practice exams for every exam that are exactly like the exam.  He is my favorite professor here at UW. TAKE HIM
Great professor, he's really energetic in class but the tests are hard because everyone learns so much.

343 can be very confusing, but with Bowman he really helps make things clear for you.  Class is worth 630 points, 600 are from exams.  Use the practice exams he gives you and you will do fine.  Also submit your exams for a regrade, ended up getting points back.  I got a bad TA, luckily you do not need to go to discussions to do well in this class.

Matt sets you up for success. The only grades in the class are participation points (up to 30), four midterms (100 points each) and a final (200 points). No quizzes, and no mandatory homework. He gives a problem set for each lecture, do these and you will succeed. Also give you about 5 practice exams for each exam which will be exactly like yours.

By far my favorite professor at UW-Madison. I was intimidated by o-chem at first but Matt definitely helped ease the stress. If you're worried about o-chem I highly recommend taking his class. The lab section was fairly easy and even though Matt wasn't there most of the time he still stayed involved and was always available during office hours.

One of the best professors I've had at UW. Cares about the success of his students, very helpful in office hours, makes jokes to lessen the stress. Would take all my chemistry classes with him if I could.
As far as chemistry instructors go at UW, Matt is by far the best I've had. Chemistry had been a difficult subject for me and Matt has taught it in a way that makes it more comprehensible.

Matt is one of the best ochem professors out there! Take him if you have the chance! If you go to all his lectures, watch his video lectures for review, and do all of the practice exams, you will get an A in the class. Don't bother buying the textbooks. He is purely lecture based.
Matt is the best professor I have ever had.  He is so nice, helpful, and is an overall great teacher.

Bowman is a super nice man. His office hours are very helpful;I suggest going.  One drawback is that his lectures are sometimes are hard to follow, and it is difficult to use a book in his class.  If you rely on reading/text, don't take him.  Also, the averages are super high, which seems nice, but you need an 88+ to get an A.  Overall, great guy.

Best prof for orgo. Exam averages were between 70 and 80. Do the problem sets and go to class. For the tests, just take his practice exams several times before the real thing and you'll be fine. Very helpful in office hours.
Best Professor at UW.  TAKE HIM for orgo

I can't say enough good things about Matt. He was beyond helpful in office hours, clear about what he wanted you to know on exams, and has a fantastic personality. Let's face it -- organic chemistry is not easy. Matt does an excellent job of explaining things and making it clear about what he wants you to know for exams. Awesome professor!

Struggled in ochem but Bowman, I was able to get an A+ on the final despite avg B. He is great at explaining mechan. and patterns so that you won't just memorize. Main thing is that many reactions are similar. Just have to see the patterns and small diff. with each. Also, go to lect, do the prob sets, but a MUST is pract. exams-same as actual exam

His class is easy meaning that everything is memorized and exams are very similar to the problem sets and straight forward. But he isn't very detailed when teaching mechanisms (things just appear) and doesn't teach 13C-NMR and mass spec which is needed in Chem 344 (although it is re-taught) while other professors teach them.
Really helpful, go to class and do the problem sets

I had Matt for 343 and 345. He gives you tons of problem sets and practice exams then supplements learning with video lectures. You'll actually be excited for lecture because Matt is hysterical. Very fair prof and just a super guy. If you have the option, take organic chemistry with THIS GUY.

Matt is the best. Amazing lecturer who commits a ton of time outside of lecture to making sure students succeed. Never had a professor who cared so much while at the same time maintaining a fun and effective learning environment. He gives you all the tools to succeed (problem sets, office hours, etc.) so if you do poorly, you can't blame him.
Excellent professor. Keeps the material interesting and wants all students to succeed. Posts videos online going through most of the reactions. Take this class with Matt if you can

By far the best teacher I have ever had and at UW. He is amazing, so passionate and gives an unreal amount of practice problems. Change your entire schedule to take him for 343 and 345. He's hilarious too. My best advice is know the reaction sheet like the back of your hand and do all the practice exams (they are just like the actual exams).

Easily the best professor I've ever had, he gives you everything you need to do well in this class and is always willing to help you, the only things you need to study for the class are his practice exams and mechanisms, he makes a difficult subject manageabe as long as you put some work in, ABSOLUTELY TAKE OCHEM WITH MATT, BEST DECISION U CAN MAKE
Phenomenal professor. Took him for the 2nd semester of O-Chem. His passion and way of relating to students actually makes the organic chemistry bearable and (dare I say) interesting.

Matt is an awesome professor; if you have to take O Chem, I recommend him immensely! Nicest professor, and offers lots of help sessions outside of class to make sure students understand the difficult material. In addition, his lectures are straightforward and he doesn't rush through material. Great professor.

He is a fantastic professor. His lectures are clear, interesting and informative. He also provides numerous problem sets as well as practice exams that allow you to properly prepare for all the tests.

Bowman was not only the best chem prof i had but the best professor I had in my first 2 years period. He is clear on what material he will test you on, does not require any text book readings and has an enormous amount of learn@uw materials to help you succeeded. O chem is hard, but if you need it, TAKE IT WITH BOWMAN! Good luck :)
BEST TEACHER AT UW. Go to class, memorize the reactions he gives you and do all the practice exams, and he is the best. Change your entire schedule to take him!

He is the best professor I have had on campus so far. He is clear with what you need to know, and is always available to help you if needed. His problem sets are wonderful, and his practice exams are clear representation of the real exams. If you want to enjoy organic chemistry (I started to love it) take Bowman. You won't regret it
Best professor I've had so far: understandable and friendly. He is willing and able to help you learn. I wish I could have him again.

Awesome professor. He puts in a huge amount of time to help you understand, puts a lot of very helpful resources online, and is generally just a nice professor. He makes long and difficult classes easy to tolerate. Wish I could have him again.

Matt is an amazing professor; very personable, with a great sense of humor and enthusiasm which keeps lectures light despite the heavy and often arduous course content. He also has a keen sense of the student's level of knowledge, and never goes over their heads. There is no excuse to fail his classes with all of the resources he provides you.

Matt Bowman is the best professor I've ever had at Madison, hands down. He offers countless problem sets, clear lecture notes, and practice exams that guide you through the process of learning the material, leaving you very well prepared for exams. Beyond that, I've never had such a funny and interesting prof, let alone in a boring science class.

Matt is the best professor I've ever had at UW. He provides you with all the resources you need and is genuinely concerned with how well his students are doing. As long as you keep up with problem sets, ask questions, and do the practice exams you will be just fine. He's also hilarious and makes lecture interesting.

Matt is one of my favorite professors. He truly cares about his students, and has a good sense of humor. He explains everything clearly and provides problem sets so the book is completely unnecessary.  Do all the problem sets and practice exams, go to some office hours, and you can do well in the class.

I've never had a professor who genuinely cared about my success as much as Matt. He goes out of his way to help his students and he's very approachable. He makes organic chemistry as interesting and understandable as it possibly can be and if you have to take ochem you should do everything you can to take it with Matt. It's worth it, trust me.

Matt is an incredible organic chem. lecturer and an equally compelling person. The man's words will allow you to understand, and he is not above anybody. His combination of understanding students' needs and leaving a trail of breadcrumbs to get them there makes him somebody you want to get to know. Oh, and his exams are VERY fair.

If you have to take Organic, do your best to get Bowman. You cannot go wrong. Tests are extremely fair, and he explains things on a level that is very understandable from an undergraduate's point of view. also he is an epic human and hilarious.

Matt is the best professor I've had at Madison! So many resources to help you do well in the class. Organic chem is tough, there is no way around that, but Matt will help you get through and even make you have a little fun along the way. If you have to take ochem try your best to get him, really cares about his students and is very approachable
A lot of practice exams and help

Matt was a good instructor with a pretty interesting class, but his curve at the end of the class was wretched.  Told a bunch of jokes, had great review sessions, problem sets, practice exams, etc.  Biggest problem was that the textbook didn't match up with the class, so you had to learn from him and had nowhere else to go.

Matt Bowman is probably the most humble, down-to-earth professor I've ever had. He is super easy to talk to. Very readily available and extremely helpful. His great sense of humor kept most all of his students coming regularly to lecture. He did a ton of cool demos too! I would most definitely take another one of his classes again.
Hard class, but probably the best professor I've had at UW
Matt is one of the best professors I have had on this campus. He supplies you with more than you need to earn an A in the class. He would be my top recommendation for any O-chem course, undoubtedly.
Matt is an excellent professor! OChem is really difficult, but he will help you get through it. Be ready to work hard, but with Matt, you will get there.
Best professor at UW. He honestly cares about how his students do and makes organic chemistry as interesting as it's going to get! Wouldn't recommend anybody else if you had to take 343.
The best professor i have had, hands down!! Very clear on what he is trying to say. He is a funny guy who cares about students more than himself.
Great professor wouldn't take take this class with anyone else.
He did not help me at all. He was very rude to me for no apparent reason. Although he does teach the topics very well. He gave exams every two weeks.

Bowman is the best professor I have ever had. He is so passionate about his work and is helpful and understanding. If you attend his office hours he is extremely kind. His exams are fair and are identical to his practice exams. Over all he made organic chemistry an awesome class! Hopefully I can have him again in the future!
BEST. PROFESSOR. EVER. This course is tough, but Bowman is a great lecturer
Good

Best Pro. that I can ever have in UW-Madison. Dr. Bowman is good at simplifying complicated material. His passion to teaching and chemistry influences students a lot. Definitely take his class if you are unsure about whether you can do well in 343/345. This Professor can magically make you to enjoy o.chem.

He is hands down the best professor I've had. Matt is extremely helpful and somehow manages to break down confusing topics into fairly easy subunits. His lectures are very clear and he finds simple patterns to help you through complicated mechanisms. He provides ample practice before the exams. Don't buy the book. TAKE THIS CLASS!!!

Matt Bowman is the best professor I've had at UW so far. Matt is helpful, organized, friendly, and an all around excellent prof. He gives you an insane amount of resources including 5-6 practice exams which all closely resemble the actual exams. Go to the review sessions he holds before tests. Highly recommend Matt to everyone taking ochem.
The class is tough, but he is equipped to help you through it.

He gives lots of practice exams which is nice but sometimes leaves out important details in lecture and some lecture materials can be difficult to understand. jumps around a lot in lecture. Overall great class and not too difficult!
Best professor I have had by far. Gives a ton of resources and is very approachable. If you go to lecture, pay attention, and do all the practice exams, you will do well in this class.

Matt is one of the best professors I've had on campus. He is obviously very passionate about teaching, with well organized, concise lectures, problem sets for every class, multiple practice exams, and detailed mechanism notes provided as handouts online. He provides all the tools needed to succeed in the class. Highly, highly recommended!

Matt is the best teacher I've ever had. I had him for 343 too and it was incredible luck to have him for 345 as well. He is one of the nicest and most caring people I've ever met. He will answer any questions, and gives good advice about future classes. His practice exams are exactly like the real exams. Greatest professor ever. I love Matt Bowman.

The best teacher/ professor I have ever had the pleasure of having. Matt is such an awesome person. He manages to make the lectures funny and informative. His exams are completely fair, being based only on lecture. He and his trusty Dr. Pepper made O Chem my favorite class this past semester.

Best Professor I've ever had. If you are taking O chem at the UW make sure you get Matt Bowman. His practice tests are EXTREMELY helpful and he is willing to answer any questions. Wonderful teacher and very approachable.

Matt was hands down the best professor I have ever had!  His lectures were fairly easy to follow and the material on exams matched that of the lectures.  They aren't really mandatory but I HIGHLY recommend you attend since he moves quickly.  I never used the textbook, but I hear you need it for 345, so buy it if you plan on taking that.

Best teacher I have ever had. Really wants students to succeed and provides many practice problems and tests. Most lectures are posted online with additional material to help students. Organic is a difficult class, but I would take this class again if I could!

Matt Bowman was a fantastic teacher. He is genuinely interested in his student's success. Lots of practice is given. The exams are incredibly fair and could have definitely been harder. He is also a wonderful person and very approachable. I can't imagine what my opinion of Ochem would be had I not taken it with Matt.

I was terrified about taking o-chem before this semester, but Matt made learning it pretty easy. He gives lots of practice problems and plenty of practice exams so you know exactly what type of problems will be asked of you. It is still an incredibly difficult course, but it is CRAZY curved at the end of the semester.

Matt is, by far, one of the best professors here on Madison. He goes out of his way to help his students, making a ridiculously great number of practice exams. His lectures are hilarious and informative, and he connects with his students well. It's a shame he isn't teaching 345 next semester!

You don't have people raving about ochem - unless of course the professor is Matt. He puts a TON of time and effort into making his class succeed, but you still have to put in effort to do well. He's also really funny and extremely approachable. I can only pray that he teaches 345.
I love Matt Bowman. The last page of the final was "Thanks for being such a good class -Matt". How do you not love this guy?

Matt is the best professor.  He is a great lecturer and he wants all of his students to succeed. He is willing to help. He makes the lectures funny and interesting. Also he provides a lot of practice exams, so you know what is expected of you for the exam. This class was one of my highlights. He got a standing ovation in the last lecture.
Matt is very enthusiastic about chemistry and extremely intelligent. Is class is really difficult and I am pretty sure I would hate it if he were not such a good lecturer

Matt is the best professor I had at UW. He is very excited about the subject, and his main goal is to really help us understand not just complete his course. In class, I've heard many times that students really loved the professor and the best proof was the last lecture when everybody stood up and applauded. The best teacher ever!

Matt was a great lecturer and is obviously very passionate about chemistry. His lectures were engaging, funny, and clear, and the exams were fair. He gives tons of practice exams and problems so it's easy to be well-prepared if you utilize what's offered. Overall the best chemistry professor I've had and one of my favorite classes this year.
The fact that he got a STANDING OVATION after our last lecture should speak volumes. Best teacher at UW by far.
A very effective teacher.   His humor, vast knowledge, and attention to students makes a difficult organic chemistry class worth taking.

Matt is the most amazing professor ever. He is so excited about ochem and loves to teach it. He cares so much about his students, and is very approachable if you have questions. He makes you think when you ask them because he really cares that we learn. This class was the highlight of my freshman year. Matt is a hilarious, caring guy. He's a stud.

Matt is hands down one of the best professors I've had. He's a REALLY nice guy, helpful, enthusiastic, puts in a lot of time to help students... Pretty much anything good, Matt is. On the last day of classes, the students applauded loudly and for a long time - Matt deserved it.

Matt is a phenomenal professor.  Not only does he really love teaching, but he also genuinely cares about how well his students do!  Tests are challenging, but if you study and really know your stuff you'll be just fine.  Problem sets are very helpful and emulate exam questions.  Don't fall behind!  Easily one of the best professors on campus!

Matt is an excellent lecturer. He goes above and beyond what is required of him. Really an exceptional guy, quite knowledgeable in his field and inspirational for those with a deeper interest in the subject.  Dropped some epic one liners about recreational use of substances in lecture, too!

very helpful instructor. you can definitely tell how much he loves ochem and teaching it. his passion drives his students to work hard. though I would not recommend him if you're not a big fan of doing problem sets.

Matt is an incredible professor. I was scared to take ochem but I ended up loving it. He is so helpful and goes out of his way to make sure you understand the material. He also keeps lectures funny and interesting. All around he is a great guy. You have to put a lot of work in, but it is worth it. I definitely recommend him.

Matt is AWESOME!  Let's face it, there are very few people who find O Chem fun and easy, so don't expect to waltz into this class and put zero effort in and get an A.  Anyways, back to Matt.  He is a wonderful professor, one of the best I've had at Madison.  And I think he is pretty darn cute, too.
Great Professor! Very clear and tests are difficult but fair.

Matt was a good lecturer for the most part. The subject material is difficult, so expect to need to put work in. Matt wrote good practice exams and problem sets. My one complaint would be that the grade was solely exam based and I felt not enough time was given. It's ochem, so you know what you're getting into

Matt is an exceptional professor. He explains everything clearly and in a way that you can understand. Besides that, he's an extremely nice guy, and wants you to do well. I was worried about ochem before this class...I left it confident. Thanks Matt

Had Matt for the summer session. You can tell that he LOVES ochem and honestly LOVES teaching it. Practice exams are the same format as real exams. Textbook is useless - Matt explains everything much better. I know a lot of people are afraid of ochem, but Matt makes it approachable and fun. Take this class with him!!!

Dr. Bowman is one of the best Professors on campus.  He is very approachable and knowledgable about chemistry. More importantly, he WANTS students to excel and be successful.  I learned more chemistry from him than any other professor.  I HIGHLY recommend him as a professor.

I couldn't have asked for a better O. Chem professor. Matt really tries make the material understandable and is always availabe for help. He writes 3 practice exams for each exam, which are identicle to the layout of the actual exams. He's also really funny.

Matt is one of the best professors on this campus. He actually makes O-Chem interesting and approachable, and if you don't understand something he is literally around 20 hours a week. His exams are very, very fair and similar to the problem sets he offers so you won't ever be surprised. I only wish every class were taught by Matt.

There's no need to be scared of ochem when Matt's your professor. Such a nice guy who obviously cares about how his students do. His examples in lecture are clear and he takes time to explain and review concepts that people have trouble with. Tests are still tricky because it is ochem after all, but nothing too terrible.
Matt is great. He's extremely helpful, and really wants you to do well. He's a funny guy and there were never really any surprises on exams.

I loved his class. He makes sense when he explains chemistry to you. I am in 345 now, and I still ask him questions. I am rocking 345, and I think it is all thanks to how well I learned 343 with Matt.
I enjoyed Matt.  He teaches the class well and more importantly, tells you exactly what you need to know for the exams, which aren't too hard.  I wish I had him again this semester.
Picture the ultimate chemistry lover and that is Matt. He is yes, very nerdy, but  because he loves chemistry so much, he's very helpful and approachable.
Haha, what a nerd. Great guy, loves students.

He's one of the best professors I've ever had! The lectures are really interesting, the homework isn't busy work, and he genuinely cares about us as individuals. He tries to make connections to Korean media he thinks we'd be interested in and he gives us a lot of autonomy when it comes to pair work and projects. He grades very leniently as well.

Prof Lim is a great, straightforward professor. I didn't always learn much during lecture, but he put in a lot of effort to make sure the content was understood. He does call on people a lot, but he won't call on you if you ask him not to. There are a lot of small homeworks, but they are very easy. He can be a little scary, but he's really nice :)
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Lim was generally a good professor and showed that he cared about his students. I definitely had a harder time learning in the class as I felt that lecture was somewhat unhelpful and I don't think I learned too much from it. Be prepared to get called on during lectures.

Great Professor! One of my favorite classes I've taken as UW-Madison. If you follow the class expectations, it's easy to get a good grade-just study and you'll do well! Very friendly to talk to, and his concern and care regarding students is easy to see. Would definitely recommend him to anyone debating taking Korean at UW-Madison.

He's an amazing professor and great at his job. He makes studying Korean fun and entertaining. Attendance is mandatory for all sections of class, but it's definitely for your own good. There's homework assigned after each class, but if you keep up with the material, it doesn't take long at all.

My favorite professor at UW. Korean can be a difficult language to learn but he makes it fun and easy. He tries to include TV, music, movies, and culture into the lectures so it's not just straight grammar and reading. There is a lot of repetition, but that's necessary for language learning. He's always super helpful and will answer any questions.

To offer a more pessimistic rating, I would not recommend this professor at all. There were only two grades for the entire class, so if one grade is poor, then the final course grade will also be poor. Minimal work though, none of the reading mattered besides the terms. The term paper at the end is tough, so get a head start on it!

The 2.5 hour lecture does get long, but he is a very knowledgeable person.  HIs past experiences allow him to go more in-depth on topics other professors don't.  However, lecture is very boring.  You have a midterm that is wroth 40% of your grade and a 20-30 page term paper.  Study the lecture and terms from the book and you'll get an A.
Don't be put off by the 2.5 hour lecture. He has so much real experience in the field that his lectures are always fascinating. Even though he seems super formal, he is very kind and willing to help.

The material wasn't thrilling, but that being said Shafer is a very knowledgable professor and I would definitely recommend him. The class consisted of a midterm, a final paper, and a final exam... which was cancelled (based on what the class voted on). Start the paper early, 20 page minimum requires a lot of work.
Very enjoyable and interesting guy, class was a little boring but overall worth it. One midterm, which was pretty easy and a 25-30 page paper. Overall pretty good class.

Professor Shafer knows a lot about American government.  However, class was fairly boring (due to long lecture).  Mid term was pretty easy, and the class votes whether or not to have a final after midterms.  20-30 page research paper also due the day of the final...ouch!

I took him for Intro to American Politics for Honors and it was a fairly easy class.  A 25-30 page research paper is about the only major thing to worry about.  His tests are not very hard and the books are not used at all. He assigns readings but very little comes from there that he doesn't cover in lecture.  Very nice guy too!
No Comments

Byron is awesome!  if you want a future in American Gov't, take his classes and get on his good side ~> he is VERY well known, and very friendly & funny once you get to know him.  don't be put off by his formality.
Seems like a review of 9th Grade civics for most of it.  Hard to stay awake.

Butcher teaches the first unit of Biochem 501 and he is an okay professor. His tries to make his lectures engaging but it really depends on you if you like the subject. He almost always runs out of time for the amount of content that he planned. The class is test heavy but as long as you study and do the practice exams, the tests are fairly easy.

Overall it was very clear that Dr Butcher cared about me and the rest of the students he taught. He is available outside of class and is willing to go beyond the lectures if you are curious about the material. Highly recommend!

Compared to the other Biochem 501 professors, I really liked Sam. He teaches in a way that is easier to understand for students that have never heard of these concepts, even though he's studied this stuff for years and does research on it. Accessible outside of class and very kind and friendly.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Extremely average instructional abilities; very mid at explaining conceptual stuff and quite bad at explaining math. Will be saving his lecture recordings to use as white noise because goodness knows they put me to sleep. Practice exams were really helpful, they're just like the real test. Overall impression: really boring but not outright awful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Butcher's lectures were always very interesting. Outside of class he was also very friendly and showed he cared about the students.
Lectures felt bland but expectations were clear. The practice problems, discussion sets, and practice exams were very helpful in learning.

Not a bad professor, just a little boring (but he was my favorite out of all 4 professors for 501). Exams are just like the practice exams. Lecture content is pretty clear and easy to understand and doesn't go too fast through it. Will answer questions willingly. I'm indifferent to taking another class with him again

Dr. Butcher is an intelligent, smart professor, and this is clear in his lectures. His abilities to teach and create an active learning environment are not so well demonstrated. His slides are very confusing and he directly reads off of them, as if we can't read, and does not explain the information on the slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are dry and can be confusing. There's a LOT of "just FYI, you won't need to know this", and not nearly enough "remember this, it's important". He also doesn't explain a whole lot on the piazza when asked (it's a lot of "as I said before,", or "determining what to use is part of the question"). No flack against the dude, but I'm not a fan.

Dr. Butcher's lectures are so disconnected and he just reads off the slides and doesn't explain anything in detail so you're screwed when it comes to the exams. Also you have to calculate pH and pKa without a calculator on the exams...... it's 2021, nobody needs to do math without a calculator.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Butcher is very engaging and I loved his section of the course! His lectures were straight forward, as was the unit 1 exam. Overall, a great choice.

Butcher was a fair professor who clearly presented the material in asynchronous lectures. The unit's content was often disjointed, but Butcher does well to make it understandable. Tests were multiple choice and straightforward.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Butcher's lectures were well-paced and very clear. Exam content matched lecture content and was more than fair- I thought the practice sheets and practice exam were harder/more in depth than the real exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Butcher is a solid biochem professor. I would recommend cranking the speed to 2x on the lecture videos or else you will probably zone out. He was straightforward on what you needed to know for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I don't understand where these good reviews are coming from. I had asked him for further clarification on a concept and he told me to "read the book and look online," which I had done. Clearly does not put forth the effort to help students outside of class, but his exams were easy enough by studying the lecture material.
Butcher is the most boring lecturer is have ever had. Yes, he gives all of the information you need but in the least stimulating way possible. His class wasn't too hard but it was very boring.

Took it online. LOVED SAM as a professor. He did a great job making it clear what was on the exam and it was very straight forward. He responded to Piazza questions fast and clear as well. Would highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Not a bad professor by any means, but not exceptional either. Tons of information on the lecture slides (he straight-up recites a lot of it), and you need to try and memorize most of it if you're looking to get an A. Not super interesting to listen to, but you could tell he cares about his students.

He was a good professor because he did his job well. He teaches what is on the exam. He does provide background information, but lets you know it is not required. His exam reflects the material covered.

He was very clear with his expectations. While there is a lot of material in he's section, he narrows down his PowerPoint slides to the main topic. Biochemistry is difficult but he was easy to understand and told you what you need to know. His exam was very similar to the practice exam and his lectures.
